tpl.title: Document templates
tpl.lead: Agreements, offer letters and welcome packs with {placeholders}, made for a customer in one step and sent with a link.
tpl.name: Name
tpl.pick_for: Pick a template to make a document for {name}.
tpl.body_help: Placeholders in braces, e.g. {company_name}. Formatting: "# " heading, "## " sub-heading, "- " list, **bold**.
tpl.delete_confirm: Delete this template? Documents already made stay.
tpl.generated: Document ready: send it from here.
tpl.documents_lead: Documents made from templates, each with a link the customer opens and prints.
tpl.doc_saved: Document saved. The customer sees it on the same link.

tpl.word_lead: A .docx with {placeholders}: its pictures, icons, links and design stay as they are.
tpl.word_is: A Word template ({file}): edit it in Word and upload it again to change the text.
tpl.word_preview: The text of the Word file (pictures and design are kept in the file).
tpl.word_doc_note: A Word document: the customer downloads the file from the link. Only the title can be changed here.
tpl.upload_lead: A presentation, a brochure or a price list: it becomes a document with its own link, sent by e-mail or WhatsApp with your message, and you see when it is opened.
tpl.upload_message_ph: Shown above the file on the link, e.g. Try MedWorks free for 14 days…
tpl.uploaded: File uploaded. Copy its link or send it.
tpl.pdf_message_help: This message is shown above the file on the link.
